name: Parallel Direct Volume Rendering with Y-Buckets and X-Buckets
aliases: Hierarchical Parallelizable Direct Volume Rendering for Irregular/Multiple Grids
Scanline-based direct volume rendering for irregular grids
definition: A parallel direct volume rendering algorithm that processes polygons (representing isosurfaces or volume slices) by grouping them into scanline-based 'y-buckets' and then processing pixels within those buckets using 'x-buckets' and 'x-actives' lists to maintain front-to-back visibility order.
summary: Parallel Direct Volume Rendering with Y-Buckets and X-Buckets is a scanline-based algorithm that efficiently renders irregular grids by grouping polygons into y-buckets and x-buckets to maintain front-to-back visibility and maximize coherence.
